summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to file updated risk factors (Exhibit 99.1) supplementing its prior annual and quarterly reports. No corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a routine risk-factor update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. As it contains no special-situation catalyst, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
